name: somali-music-archive
description: Somali Music AI Preservation Platform — a permanent, research-grade archive of Somali traditional music. Monorepo root.
author: Khalid Ibrahim <hrgysa123@gmail.com>
//: WHY npm workspaces + Turborepo: one repo holds the mobile app, web app, Node API, Python AI service, and shared TS packages so a single type or validator change propagates everywhere at once. Turborepo caches task output so CI and local builds only re-run what actually changed. This must scale from 1 developer to a team without a rewrite (ARCHITECTURE.md Principle 6).
//overrides: React is pinned to the exact version Expo SDK 57 expects. Without this, npm hoists a newer patch for the web app and nests a second copy under apps/mobile — two React instances break hooks on the phone and in jest.
//lint-staged: Runs on staged files only (via the husky pre-commit hook), so commits stay fast. Prettier auto-formats and re-stages. Per-app ESLint joins this list once each app's eslint config lands (Phase 1). Prettier honours .prettierignore, so ignored paths (e.g. package-lock.json, *.md) are skipped.
